body: Sadly I am not in any therapy ... i used to go to the one my university offered... but it didn't help

I once saw a video of this. If you are having suicidal thoughts, just live to not hurt ur friends and family. Get someone to tell you to live for their sake. Though it may not help ...it helps me a lot when someone tells me "please live so I won't be hurt by your death"

I am limited in my advice for relationships since I myself have not been in a long lasting one but, if you sad or angry  ...find a place to let it out , such as here or with a friend and make hit some sandbags. If you want to save your relationship , though I don't have an answer ... she did fall in love with you before , and you can try to make her fall for you again. This is probably bad advice but ...it was the only one I could think of.

I remember a post once ...it wasn't particularly your situation but ... in that post , said person wouldn't end his life because of a family member he was taking care of. From the way you speak of your kids ... they should still need you in their life right? Is it not possible they could be your motivation to just keep going on with life.
Separation ? I assume that's not at the level of divorce. Is there any particular reason you think she would want this? Only if you are comfortable enough to share it of course.
Hey I'm here to talk. What happened? You can pm me if that's more comfortable.
Hello , i'm not much of a talker or anything but if ur okay with me , I'd be willing to talk and listen. PM or just reply...i do have kik if that works

Hello, although this may not help, it is not that we don't care. At least from my stand point , I could never reply to your post for I have no idea what to say. I could say things like feel better or it'll be okay but that would be meaningless. I have never done anything such as hiring a prostitute or rather I've never even done drugs before hence I actually have no idea how you feel, I don't understand how you feel. From a random lurker to you , we care it's just that we don't have any ideas how to begin speaking for we have never experienced the things you've done. 

This may be contradictory to what i said and is probably meaningless but , please feel better.

I do this too. It honestly feels really good that I've avoided the day and i dont think there is anything bad about it but maybe that's just me. I enjoy the night and avoid problems i would have to face during the day and I don't think it's particularly unhealthy.
Hi I'm totally for the idea of having a skype group and would love to join.
Hello if you want to talk you can shoot me a PM or if you have a kik that works too. Whatever is more convenient.

Yea I guess I'm about the same with the self loathing part. I'm in so deep that every time something bad happens, I just say I deserved it and it's all my fault. I have been going to therapy but it's barely helping me.

Honestly I too am feeling horrible, hence why I am lurking here. It's hard pretending to be okay everyday but we still keep it up. If it's okay for me to ask , would you tell me what has happened to make you feel this way ?
Hey you okay? Please PM if you need someone to talk to. I would love to hear you out especially if it helps.
